messages:
Noah: T-minus 30m for sunset rollmate. calling a hard quiet window at T-25. list any running jobs now.
Keisha: I paused two ETL jobs touching model-snapshots and scheduled a retry after the window.
Diaz: QA finished the regression pass on rerank and embeddings. sample checks ok but one flaky prompt (see thread).
Noah: Mark that flaky prompt as p1 and Priya will own quick follow-up if it regresses during canary.
Deploy-bot: :robot_face: Preflight summary: all infra green except one ASG with 1 unhealthy instance. will proceed after infra heal. rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, 3m observation each. gates: 200 OKs, p99 < 300ms, errors < 0.25%.
SRE-Oncall: Alerting thresholds set. rollback trigger: error > 0.25% for 3m OR sustained p99 > 400ms for 5m.
Priya: Product hold for final sign-off in 10m. will run evaluator set of 100 p0 prompts at each step.
Keisha: Pin configuration applied: model rwd/medium-v3@v2026-03-18, routing primary eu-west, backup us-west, quant q3_1. cache disabled for canary to avoid warmup noise.
Infra-bot: :information_source: Certs check passed. autoscaler snapshot stable.
Noah: Rollback owners: Keisha (pin/unpin), Diaz (quality rollback decision), SRE-Oncall (infra rollback). If rollback: use `infra model rollback --target rwd/medium-v3@v2026-03-04 --force` and notify #customers if >10% traffic affected.
Deploy-bot: :warning: Canary gate blocked: control-plane lease delay 45s. retrying.
Keisha: Kicking lease renew now.
Deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Lease acquired. spinning up canary slice.
Deploy-bot: Reached 5% traffic. observation window started.
Diaz: Running smoke eval N=100: top-level metrics within baseline, one prompt regressed (the flaky one). tracking.
Priya: Noted. will re-run that prompt at 25% and confirm.
SRE-Oncall: Infra metrics OK. GPU util 62%, mem stable.
Deploy-bot: Stepping to 25% now.
Diaz: 25% results: flaky prompt passes twice, rest stable. quality safe to continue.
Deploy-bot: Stepping to 60% now. observation window started.
Keisha: Reminder: we intentionally disabled cache for canary. after 100% we will re-enable with TTL=8m and watch cache hit rate.
Noah: Keep an eye on token/sec for embeddings. threshold alert if > +25% baseline for >10m.
Infra-bot: :bell: cost watch alert rule created and notifying Ops.
SRE-Oncall: At 60% p99 temporarily hit 320ms for 4m, but dropped after autoscaler added capacity. not a trigger.
Deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% after steady windows.
Priya: Final eval at full traffic: pass for p0 prompts. product green.
Deploy-bot: :rocket: Rollout complete. final status: success.
Keisha: Publishing release notes and runbook update. added steps to quick-unpin: `infra pin remove --model rwd/medium-v3@v2026-03-18` and emergency rollback example above.
Noah: Post-deploy monitor window: 90m. owners: Keisha + SRE-Oncall. escalate to Priya for any customer-visible regression.
Diaz: Leaving note in runbook about the flaky prompt and test harness seed to reproduce.
Priya: Will prepare a short customer note draft in case we need to communicate impact.
Noah: Great work. unlocking normal ops after 90m if all metrics stable. thumbs up from product and infra. :thumbsup:
